description:
List graded books, newest first, one summary row each: date, returns, alpha against SPY and RSP, and verdict.
    A book (or batch) is one trading day's full S&P 500 slate. Use this to find a trading_date, then get_resolved_batch
    for every forecast in that book or verify_batch for its proof. Dates with no graded book return an empty list.

from_date.description: Earliest date to include, as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for no lower bound.
from_date.title: From Date

limit.description: Most books to return, 1 to 500. Default 60.
limit.title: Limit

to_date.description: Latest date to include, as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for no upper bound.
to_date.title: To Date

name: list_resolved_batches
title: Book history
